name: meural-signage
description: Self-hosted signage dashboard (weather, Spotify, Entetsu bus, train status, Google Calendar) rendered in a headless browser and streamed to a Meural Canvas via meural-hls.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace web & npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck --workspace server
